spec.scope: every bp delta a face of the family publishes at ERA level; deltas nested inside per-month / per-name lists are internal arithmetic and are counted, not classified

abs_sum_of_name_deltas.meaning: a SUM of absolute per-name arm deltas (turnover of the level), not a difference of two levels

arm_delta_of_screen_output.meaning: screening outputs (tilt / spread / neutral) carry no fee term

cross_measure_pair.meaning: two different measures of one era, neither a curve reading

cross_stance.meaning: one operand gross, the other net: the whole fee sits inside the delta

external_operands.meaning: operands live on a sibling face

from_two_published_levels.meaning: both operands are published levels; the difference inherits nothing

same_stance_arm_delta.meaning: two readings of ONE stance across arms: carries fee_raw minus fee_screened

unnamed_operand.meaning: the label names the arithmetic but not the object it differences

spec.verification: a cell REPRODUCES when a construct this family can build from the published ladders lands within tolerance; a cell whose value is the NEGATIVE of a construct reproduces_flipped_sign and is reported as a sign-convention difference, not as a match
spec.units: bp as published by the producing face

sign_convention_of_reproduced_deltas.note: `same` means the printed number is the construct the rule names; `flipped` means it is that construct negated, so the faces print screened-minus-raw where the rule reads raw-minus-screened

answers.reading: 152 bp delta cells published at era level: 30 reproduce a build path inside their own era cell, 30 reproduce a ladder construct only with the opposite sign, 0 contradict theirs, 58 are zero-valued and 34 cannot be checked from either source. 77 are fee-free by construction, 10 take the absolute value of per-name arm deltas and 0 differ the two stances - the only construct that would carry the whole fee is published nowhere as a delta. Max arm fee difference available to be inherited is 0.0754 bp, and 0 cell(s) would print less than a fee they actually carried. Sign convention is uniform (screened minus raw): the printed delta is the construct negated. 3 cell(s) carry a stance word in their name while being fee-free.

honest: the build path of a cell is bound by its own NAME and then verified against a construct computed from the published ladders; a cell whose label does not name its operand is matched by number and that match is published as a reading, not as a declaration
a flipped-sign reproduction is a sign convention, not a wrong number: the two faces are each internally consistent and disagree with each other
era-level only: 380 deltas nested inside per-month / per-name lists are counted and excluded - they are internal arithmetic of a parent cell, not a quote a reader takes away
a fee-free verdict says the delta inherits nothing from the fee, not that the delta is right
